newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 13.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 13.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Cold front expected to lower temperatures in northern Baja California peninsula and bring scattered showers to northwest Sonora. Winds from the north at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/19 to 22 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.
Rest of coast clear or party cloudy with mild wind speeds.
Light rains along coast of Tamaulipas and Veracruz states. Possible rains along Yucatan peninsula with maximum winds from the south at between 10 and 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour).
Hot and partly cloudy with some rains, moderate southeastern winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
